kebab_example: aliyun sas add-image-vul-white-list --target type_:_repo_,_target_:_sas_test/script_0209_,_sas_test/script --whitelist Type_:_sca_,_Name_:_imgsca:java:spring-core:AVD-2022-1124599_,_AliasName_:_Spring_Framework_JDK_=_9_CVE-2022-22965 --type cve --reason already_config_in_another_way --lang zh --source image --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddImageVulWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The object on which you want to perform the operation. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

type: the object type. The value is fixed to repo.
target: the object content. The value is in the Namespace/Image repository format
parameters.help_zh:
操作目标。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

type：目标类型，固定为repo
target：目标内容，格式：命名空间/镜像仓
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

Type: the vulnerability type. Valid values: cve and sca.
Name: the name of the vulnerability that is specified in Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE).
AliasName: the alias of the vulnerability that is specified in CVE
parameters.help_zh:
白名单。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

Type：漏洞类型：cve/sca
Name：漏洞公告中的名称
AliasName：漏洞公告中的别名
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

cve: system vulnerability
sca: application vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值包括：
cve：系统漏洞
sca：应用漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The reason why you add the vulnerability to the whitelist
parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:
image
agentless
parameters.help_zh:
白名单来源。取值：
image：镜像
agentless：agentless
parameters.name: source
